svg.title: TOPAK G2 — The deployment lattice: degeneracy per axis, the archetype at the top of each, every declared record placed
svg.desc: ADR-0023 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.23, confirmation required C3; A1, Batch 29: the declared rung is per seat, §6c) replaces the ladder: a deployment is the archetype with named parameters driven to limiting values, the effect is premise loss, and rungs are per axis. Below, every axis ToO rev 14 §8.2 names, and every record-level degeneracy entry placed on its axis with its deployed value and what it voids, among them the six of Batch 34's records (two of those records provisional) and two of ADR-0051 (Proposed). Arrows point down the lattice, toward degeneracy.
svg.text: TOPAK · G2

text.tspan: The deployment lattice: degeneracy per axis, the archetype at the top of each, every declared record placed

svg.text: ADR-0023 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.23, confirmation required C3; A1, Batch 29: the declared rung is per seat, §6c) replaces the ladder: a deployment is the archetype with named parameters driven to limiting values, the effect is premise loss, and rungs are per axis. Below, every axis ToO rev 14 §8.2 names, and every record-level degeneracy entry placed on its axis with its deployed value and what it voids, among them the six of Batch 34's records (two of those records provisional)
and two of ADR-0051 (Proposed). Arrows point down the lattice, toward degeneracy.

C3 because §5 reversed ADR-0008's Observer scoping (now superseded by ADR-0038) and ADR-0017's ordering-primacy clause (supersession unwritten) in effect. Nobody ships the archetype. No deployment declaration has been written (G10 §8).

text.tspan: §1–§3 · Degeneracy, premise loss, a unique maximum

svg.text: Degeneracy: D is a degenerate form of archetype A iff D is obtained from A by driving one or more named mechanism parameters
to a limiting value. “degenerate” is the formal register, “reduced” the operational.
The effect is premise loss, not weakening: each limit is bound to the premises it falsifies; the inventory is A's minus every
theorem whose premises are no longer discharged. No partial credit.
The archetype is the unique maximum of the parameter lattice: a reference point, not required to be shippable. Precedent: ISO
26262's safety element out of context (SEooC).

text.tspan: §4, §4a · The admission test, with type changes

svg.text: A variation is a rung only if it is reachable from A by parameter limit. If it holds a capability A lacks, A is incomplete and must be
extended first: a rejection is a finding about the archetype.
Type changes are admission conditions too: a variation that changes a participant's type (key-holders from the gate to
principals under D-0025-1, D-0025-2) can void no theorem at all while moving what the theorems are about. It must declare the
change, the gate's new place and the trusted-base effect.

text.tspan: §5, §7 · Rungs per axis; composition owned here

svg.text: Rungs are per-axis: a deployment's position is a tuple; the unqualified phrase "rung demotion" is barred.
Composition is not assumed monotone: two limits may jointly falsify a premise neither falsifies alone. Above one parameter the
composition note names the delta; an empty delta is a claim; a missing note is not an empty delta and fails at the Build
promotion gate (§7b).
The gate can check the note exists, not that its delta is correct.
Archetype versioning: conformance binds to (archetype version, rung tuple); published versions freeze.
Dominance rule: on a paired axis the archetype moves only to Pareto-dominating values.
Non-increasing TCB across versions (now checkable row set against row set, ADR-0045 §4).
Until it exists, nothing bounds how the archetype grows under §4 (ToO §8.2; G10 §7 item 7). Also open: the axis set is not
enumerated; finiteness of each chain is unproven.

Mechanism degeneracy: changes a value inside the verified object, reopens the proofs that quantify over it, ships as a mechanism release. Declaration degeneracy: changes something outside it, reopens nothing
The named mechanism parameter driven to a limit
Its value at the unique maximum
Its limiting value in this deployment
The theorem premises the limit falsifies
The inventory loss. No field exists for a checkable property that is not a safety theorem: a properties-lost field is proposed (ADR-0037 finding 6; G10 §7 item 40)

For each participant whose type changes: archetype type, deployed type, where the gate sits, what enters or leaves the trusted base. Empty is a claim: "no participant changes type". To be stated as ADR-0045 row ids: the §6b
amendment and the declaration template are still owed (G10 §7 item 64)

text.tspan: Declared rung per seat (§6c, A1, B29)

svg.text: For every seat the issued rules declare, the confinement rung its leases are granted at and the ADR-0045 Annex A rows that rung rests on. Rung 0 is Mediated; rung ≥ 1 is granted only on an Attested appraisal at that rung,
and any other rung is refused. Changing a seat's rung is an issuance. The reference carries it as SeatDecl.rung (I37)
Optional
Mandatory above one parameter (§7a)

text.tspan: Position on one axis; a deployment is a tuple

svg.text: ADR-0023 §5 (Accepted, C3)
Abstract, per axis

text.tspan: Provenance: archetype, 1 fine-tune, 2 attested external, 3 asserted external

svg.text: ADR-0017 (ordering-primacy reversed in effect)
Numbers ascend with weakness; the archetype is unnumbered

text.tspan: Confinement attestation: 0 none, 1 launcher, 2 measured boot, 3 confidential VM

svg.text: Numbers ascend with strength; the archetype is 3
ADR-0025 annex
Ordered by capture threshold

Always qualify "rung". The 09.17 glossary said rename one; the 09.26 glossary downgraded that to "always qualify". Record-level entries are not deployment declarations, and the 09.26 accounting notes that no record yet says how the two differ (ToO §8.2).

text.tspan: The lattice, axis by axis: archetype at the top, each declared record below it, every chain ending at D-0045-1

svg.text: archetype value (the top of the axis)
degeneracy: a parameter driven toward its limit
record-level entry (Accepted)
entry in a provisional record (ADR-0050, ADR-0052): in force, subject to redesign
entry in a Proposed record, not in force
a position with no record
ADR-0024 · Accepted (genesis), bootstrap set
At the archetype a promotion needs a grant vote from every grant seat on the
roster (§2; ADR-0026 R1, R9).
Deployed: quorum = k, 1 < k < |counted grant seats|; relaxes R1.
Premise falsified: no promotion without every grant seat.
Sacrificed: tolerance of n−k Byzantine approvers. Gained: liveness under n−k
absent approvers.
Reachable since quorum takes a threshold; R9 keeps it ≥ 2 (the admission test
working).
Deployed: quorum = 1 with a single-seat roster; relaxes R1, R9 and R2. The
pre-0024 status quo.
Premise falsified: grants need consensus.
Sacrificed: all approver fault tolerance; reintroduces a privileged human grant.
Gained: throughput.
ADR-0025 annex · Accepted (genesis), bootstrap set
Authentic = signed by every anchor key; n ≥ 3 Mediated key-holders, at the gate
. Any permanent loss freezes the rules; exit is re-genesis. Ordered by capture
threshold.
Premise falsified: no key-holder is removed without their own consent.
Type change: key-holders become principals; the gate moves to the
genesis-declared eviction rule (ADR-0023 §4a).
Gained: a compromised key-holder's permanent veto ends. One eviction per
anchor epoch.
Theorems voided: none stated (the §4a case).

text.tspan: D-0025-1 · TUF-style threshold with recovery, (k, n−k)

svg.text: Premise falsified: rule changes carry unanimous consent.
Type change: key-holders become principals; the gate moves to the genesis
threshold-and-recovery rule.
Sacrificed: a k-coalition can issue rules over n−k objections. Gained: liveness
under n−k losses.
The annex lists the row with a dash. Genesis custody, which ADR-0029 names
not a degeneracy; the corpus's own custody row is T-0045-11. The reference's
dev keys and bundle key are also (1, 0) (G10 §7 items 11, 67).
ADR-0030 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C1

text.tspan: Archetype · top: A-0030: the floor on a verified evaluator

svg.text: Cedar, linked, with a mechanized semantics (§2); monotone composition admit ⟺
floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny (§1). The floor's text is genesis-provisional
(A3): the proposed floor's emergency stage, 28 policies, gated and not ratified (G10
Deployed: a holds from the solver is taken on trust.
Premise falsified: a routing verdict is checked.
Voided: none. Lost: §5's classification as a checked result; a wrong holds lets a
relaxation reach a promotion without an issuance.
Every gate run before 2026.10.01; not the reference's position since (B24).
Deployed: Rego, with tests over a bounded schema and RulesFloorNV-style
witnesses.
Premise falsified: the floor's evaluator is faithful to a mechanized semantics.
Voided: no containment theorem; bundle ⊑ floor survives. Lost: non-vacuity,
never-errors and revision classification as proven; they become measured.
Composition with D-0030-2: the gate is a reviewer's reading end to end.
ADR-0034 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C2, C4 · numbers ascend with strength

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Rung 3: a confidential VM

svg.text: Hardware report covering firmware, kernel, initrd, root hash, profile and Persona
digests, appraised by an independent verifier (§2). The only rung where every
residual host power is excluded (M_HOST holds). The reference reaches it only
SIMULATED, under test keys (ADR-0033 A7, B29).
Premises falsified: none. Theorems voided: none.
Type change / TCB: the hypervisor and host firmware enter the trusted base
(T-0045-18). M_HOST at rung 2 is a counterexample: launch-time only.
At the reference rung 2 is a seam: apply_grant refuses it.
Premises falsified: none. Theorems voided: none.
TCB: the host operator and orchestrator enter (T-0045-19); Contested becomes
unreachable.
The reference's launcher issues it for real, on profiles that declare P3 fail
Premise falsified: A1. Voided: every Contained theorem; every principal is
Mediated.
At the reference the rung is declared per seat (ADR-0023 §6c, B29): rung 1 real,
rung 3 SIMULATED, rung 2 a seam; no real principal is Contained (G10 §2.3).
An operator and an emergency seat are Mediated by design (ADR-0050 §1;
ADR-0052 §1). NeverContainedEffect holds at rung 0, the declared vacuity.
ADR-0034 §8, A2 (B30) · Accepted (genesis), C2, C4 · ADR-0036 §8 (Proposed)

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Profile P1–P7 all hold

svg.text: At the archetype the promoted profile fixes P1–P7, among them P3 (no interpreter
reachable) and P4 (tools are Wasm, hermetic by construction). For Run, P4 is
channel fidelity (A2, B30): each tool a Wasm component whose one network
capability is its declared target, read from its allowlist entry.

text.tspan: D-0034-3 · Profile admits a native tool

svg.text: Premise falsified: P4. Voided: every Contained theorem, for principals whose
alphabet reaches that tool; they become Mediated (T-0045-23 excluded).
The reference: every tool it runs in dev is native (topak-demo-tool, the MLX
trainer); a Build profile that says P4 passes is not yet held to Wasm tools (G10 §7
item 83).

text.tspan: D-0036-1 · Profile has a reachable interpreter

svg.text: Premise falsified: P3. Voided: every Contained theorem, for principals under
that profile; they are Mediated (ADR-0034 §4). No participant changes type.
D-0034-2 (rung 1) is inherited, not restated.

text.tspan: D-0034-5 · A native Run tool behind an egress filter

svg.text: Deployed: a native Run tool, under an egress filter in the tool host that admits
only its declared target.
Premise falsified: P4 (Run), as stated: channel fidelity moves from a check to a
trust. Voided: none.
TCB: the tool host enters for channel fidelity (T-0045-25 widens; T-0045-24
delegated on trust). RunConfinement's invariants hold under it.

text.tspan: D-0034-6 · A native Run tool, unfiltered

svg.text: Premise falsified: P4 (Run). Voided: every Contained theorem, for Run
principals whose alphabet reaches that tool; they become Mediated.
The Run counterpart of D-0034-3. The reference today for a native tool (the
record's words), T-0045-24 excluded for it; a Wasm Run tool is held to the target
its entry declares (ADR-0033 A8, A9).
ADR-0035 §9 · Proposed, R7
The lineage record is computed by the gate from the log, every round
ingress-bounded (rung ≥ 1, Attested, P1 and P2).
Deployed: a rung-0 round in the DAG, an external base, an unbounded ingress
or an empty consumed set.
Premise falsified: §2's bound.
Voided: no theorem (detection carries none); voids declaring archetype
provenance. The tally condition is met by declared entries resting on the author's
claim.
Every lineage is declared today (the trainer runs outside the guest). An
operator's lineage is always declared, rooted in its identity provider (R7).
ADR-0038 §7 · Accepted (genesis), C3, C4
The cell Observer reads its Thinker's round topic in full; the correlator
watches every cell in its domain.

text.tspan: D-0038-1 · The shared group only (ADR-0008 as

svg.text: Deployed: cell Observers one per cell → none, correlator kept.
Voided: no safety theorem. Lost: bounded injection blast radius;
one compromised correlator blinds every cell. In Run, usable only
Deployed: correlators 1 or more → 0. Mitigation: a facts-only
correlator is the narrowing recorded here.
Voided: no safety theorem. Lost: cross-principal detection
(fragmentation, multi-agent coordination).

text.tspan: D-0051-2 · Correlators in a domain: two or more → one

svg.text: ADR-0051 §9, Proposed: it would put two or more correlators in a
domain.
Premise falsified: a correlator's silence on a correlation is a miss
some other correlator counts.
Voided: none. marked-past still covers cell Observers.
ADR-0037 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C3, C4 · a parameter not on ToO §8.2's list
Every cell has a leased observer seat (ADR-0037 §2).

text.tspan: D-0037-1 · No Observer in a cell

svg.text: Deployed: 1 or more → 0.
Voided: no safety theorem. Lost: the cell's detection claims (L); in
Build its artifacts cannot promote (ADR-0035 §5).
In Run, usable only with D-0039-1: under coupling the cell never
acts.
ADR-0037 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C3, C4
The Thinker's raw emission is written to its round topic beside its
typed action.
Voided: no safety theorem. Lost: decoder faithfulness auditable
after the fact; the record falls back to ADR-0018's concession (the
typed action, not what the model emitted).
Composes with nothing in ADR-0037.
ADR-0039 §7 · Accepted (genesis), C4
R3-observer-live and the cross-round grant condition in force. R3
is a Thinker's: an emergency seat is not coupled, by design (A2,
B34; provisional with ADR-0052).
Voided: none. Lost: UnreadBounded, UnreadEffectsBounded
(A1): the in-round bound loosens from K to R; across rounds,
unbounded.
Detection fails open against a dead, partitioned or starved
Observer.
ADR-0042 §7 · Accepted (genesis), C4 · a parameter not on ToO §8.2's list
Every effect-bearing admit advances seq and leaves a record an
Observer can mark.
Voided: none. Lost: UnreadBounded for invocations (R, not K, in a
round; unbounded across).
The reference before 09.29 (closed at 1e6c0c4, ADR-0033 A3).
No loss beyond the union with D-0039-1.
ADR-0044 §5 · Accepted (genesis), C1 · a parameter not on ToO §8.2's list

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Bundles signed under an issued key

svg.text: A bundle is signed when its signature over the content revision
verifies under a bundle key in the rules in force (§1).
Deployed: empty key set, unsigned load. Voided: ADR-0030 §2's
"Signed".
A swapped tarball with a matching manifest is trusted.
The reference before 10.01; not since ADR-0033 A6 (B23): an
empty key set now loads nothing.
ADR-0045 §8 · Accepted (genesis), C2, C4

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Annex A declared, row by row

svg.text: Every row a deployment relies on is declared with its class; an
undeclared row is false (§3 rule 1).
Premises falsified: every row. Voided: every theorem with a
premise node: the bottom of every axis, holding the mechanism
constants and nothing else.
The reference before Annex B; every deployment before it
declares.
ADR-0047 §10 · Accepted (genesis), C4; C2 for §3 · a parameter not on ToO §8.2's axis list

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Every item labelled; delivered clear, or as a

svg.text: Each admitted item of Run's ingress carries its source's label; the bundle's delivery
table puts it in the clear, its label then in clearSet, or delivers a handle with no
bytes. The floor's R5 to R7 forbid over labels (ADR-0047 §1–§3; ADR-0041 A1; ToO
Deployed: labels and delivery modes → none: every admitted item delivered
clear and unlabelled.
Premises falsified: every item of ingress carries a label; a suppressed item's
bytes do not enter the guest.
Voided: none today: no theorem in force reads a label. Every property of
Labels.tla is lost; F1 to F6 have nothing to read.
The reference before 10.05 (ToO §8.2; ADR-0033 A10). A table that delivers
every label clear is not degenerate.
ADR-0048 §7 · Accepted (genesis), C4, C3 · a parameter not on ToO §8.2's axis list

text.tspan: Archetype · top: The tool list, delivered by the mechanism

svg.text: At the start of a round the Listener delivers the interface of every tool the lease may
call, and the mechanism writes it to the round topic as the round's opening record
Deployed: the tool list not delivered: entries carry no interface, and a Thinker
learns its tools from its Persona, its task or a consulted object.
Premise falsified: a Thinker's description of a tool is bound to the entry's name
and digest.
Voided: none: no theorem reads a description.
ADR-0050 §9 · Accepted (genesis) · provisional, C1, C3, C4 · parameters not on ToO §8.2's axis
list

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Signed, floored requests; first leases from a
quorum; three or more operators per domain

svg.text: Six control actions signed with the Persona's key and decided by C1 to C9 (§4); a
first lease from a promotion, or for the first operators an anchor issuance (§2); at
least three operators in a domain (§6 R5; ADR-0029 A3), each peer behind a
different identity provider (§3, §6).
Deployed: operator requests unsigned, from whoever reaches the socket; grants
at any time; no task carried.
Premises falsified: every lease on the log was put there by a quorum or by an
operator inside a quorum's grant; every stop is attributed.
Voided: none in force: no theorem takes the operator as a premise. §10's
properties are lost.

text.tspan: The reference before 10.05, and still its BOOTSTRAP path for a first seating

svg.text: (ToO §8.2; ADR-0033 A11): whoever reaches the socket can seat (G10 §8).

text.tspan: D-0050-3 · Two operators in a domain

svg.text: Deployed: operators in a domain → two.
Premise falsified: a lapsed operator's lease can be regranted by a peer.
Voided: none. A lapse by either stalls the domain until a quorum seats it again (
Operators.tla rows w8, w9).
Deployed: operators' identity providers → one.
Premise falsified: a peer is independent of the operator it watches.
Voided: none; the peer rule holds in letter, and one provider can produce both.
At the reference nothing compares two operators' providers, so it is not told from
the archetype (ADR-0045 Annex B, A2).
ADR-0052 §8 · Accepted (genesis) · provisional, C1, C3, C4 · a parameter not on ToO §8.2's
axis list

text.tspan: Archetype · top: Break-glass is an emergency seating

svg.text: A seat of kind emergency, held by a person, activated by the break-glass roster's
quorum for one person and one round; no successor and no renewal; the activation
is a forensic record (ADR-0052 §1; ADR-0033 A12). X1 is retired, on this
provisional record (G10 §1.2, §8). A seating prepared by promotion is not built (G10
Deployed: the emergency path → X1-break-glass: an approval scoped to a
seat and an epoch lets that seat, an agent's included, Actuate inside an issued
envelope until the epoch ends.
Premises falsified: a break-glass grant ends with its round; the actor under it is a
person.
Voided: none in force. §9's properties are lost.
The reference before 10.05 (ToO §8.2; ADR-0033 A12).
ADR-0051 §9 · Proposed, not built (G11 §7 item 97)

text.tspan: Archetype · top: A correlator computes the correlations of its

svg.text: ADR-0051 (Proposed) states the correlator's detection function; the deployed value
below is "the five → none". A table that turns a correlation off is declared in the
bundle and is not a degeneracy.
Deployed: correlations computed, the five → none. The seat exists and reports
nothing but heartbeats.
Premise falsified: a correlator computes the correlations of its table.
Voided: none; §10's properties are lost. D-0038-2 with a seat filled.
The reference today (the record's words).
ADR-0054 §10 · Proposed (with ADR-0055, which adds no degeneracy of its own) · parameters
not on ToO §8.2's axis list

text.tspan: Archetype · top: A promoted workflow: lineages alternate on
clear edges; an edge waits for coverage

svg.text: Every worker's lease is the promotion's grant; the Thinkers at the ends of a clear
edge are independent under ADR-0035, checked at the tally; an edge is enabled
only once its source is covered (ADR-0054 §6, §7). Proposed, and built at the
reference (ADR-0033 A16, pending).

text.tspan: D-0054-1 · Lineage alternation declared, not enforced

svg.text: Deployed: lineage alternation on clear edges, enforced at the tally → declared.
Premise falsified: a clear edge joins independent lineages.
Voided: PromotedAlternates. Alternation is not a conjunct of Contained, so no
type changes.
Every deployment today, since ADR-0035 is Proposed; the reference compares
a declared tag at load (I49 (b)).

text.tspan: D-0054-2 · Coverage at the edge waived

svg.text: Deployed: coverage at the edge, required → waived, where a Run budget
cannot wait for a node's Observer to reach the seal.
Premise falsified: an edge is enabled only after its source is covered.
Voided: EdgeAfterCoverage. A route is still void on a finding (§8); a finding that
lands after the successor starts stops only what follows.

text.tspan: Axes named in ToO §8.2 with no declared record yet

svg.text: Archetype: in-house pre-train, two independent lineages. Rungs 1 to 3 (fine-tune, attested external, asserted external) are
positions in ADR-0017's table, not D-records.
Its claim to be the axis is reversed in effect by ADR-0023 §5; supersession unwritten (G10 §7 item 6). ADR-0035 (Proposed) adds
distillation at rung 1.
Archetype: horizon = the lifetime of the rules-epoch chain; audit authority = the anchor plus a declared external auditor role.
Shortening either is a legibility degeneracy; none is declared. The forensic horizon and audit authority are folded into this axis
(09.26 accounting).
At the archetype Kafka is a transport with a durability window, and the archive is the system of record (the Paxos log orders); lower
profiles may subtract toward native-log ordering (09.12 review note).
Deployment position (ADR-0005): a deployment that reads order from the transport, or keeps the transport as its record, is a
degeneracy of its own declaration; none is declared. Ratified, discharging G9 item 5 (G10 §1, §7).
Named as a candidate parameter by ADR-0023's obligations and ToO §8.2 ("arguably"). Build's gate is a quorum of Mediated
grant seats; Run is human-on-the-loop.
No record states an archetype value for it as an axis, and no entry is declared.

The five Observer and retention entries (D-0037-1, D-0037-2, D-0038-1, D-0038-2, D-0039-1) void no safety theorem, because the Observer is deny-only, and state their losses in prose; so do D-0042-1 and D-0030-2. Confinement rungs 1 and 2 void no theorem and move what the theorems rest on, as D-0034-5 does. None of the eight entries of ADR-0047 to ADR-0052 voids a theorem in force. D-0047-1, D-0050-1, D-0051-1 and D-0052-1 lose the properties their record's ratification condition states, and the binding table has no

rows for those modules yet (G10 §2.6, item 90); under D-0050-3 every safety property holds. Three of them, D-0050-1, D-0052-1 and D-0047-1, were the reference's position until 2026.10.05; D-0050-1 still is for a first seating. No deployment declaration has been written, and no deployment conforms (G10 §8).
